name: Info item
description: Icon in a circle with a bold title and a text or link: contact details, opening hours, feature strips. Lists use es-info-list with data-cols.
useWhen: Contact details (phone, email, address, opening hours)
Feature or benefit strips under a hero or in a footer

parts.es-info-list: Grid of items; data-cols for fixed columns

examples.title: Outline icons on a dark surface
examples.description: data-style="outline" uses the text colour, so the circle keeps its outline on dark surfaces. Phone and email as links.

examples.title: Soft icons with accent tint
examples.description: data-style="soft" uses the tone surface with tone text. Good for a light section with several contact channels.

examples.title: Solid icons in a row
examples.description: Default solid circle. Four items in one row; they wrap to two columns on tablets and one on phones.

examples.title: Feature strip
examples.description: The same item as a feature row: accent icons on a dark background, title plus short description.

examples.title: Compact
examples.description: data-size="sm" with neutral soft icons for footers, sidebars and dense pages.
